This rice plot is small but it is my main rice ground, and rice needs water and good feeding to give grain, so I will put fertilizer if I can get it from the agro-dealer in town. I plant in the fadama so water is there from the stream and the wet soil — I do not pump, I just channel the water. I will use the FARO seed my neighbor shared with me last year because it gave better grain than the local one. Rice work is heavy — transplanting and harvest — so my wife, my brother and I will do most of it, but I will pay some young men for the transplanting days because we cannot finish alone.
